data.one_liner: Save any file type to device storage, gallery, or a user‑chosen folder with progress and conflict handling.
data.what_it_does: This plugin writes bytes to the local file system or gallery on mobile, desktop, and web. It supports native FFI/JNI for high performance and provides real‑time progress updates, cancellation, and conflict resolution.
use_when: You need to download or generate a file and store it locally or in the gallery.
You require progress feedback or cancellation for large files.
You need cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web).
avoid_when: You only need simple file I/O that can be handled by dart:io or path_provider.
You are targeting a single platform and prefer a minimal dependency footprint.
strengths: Native performance via FFI/JNI, no method channel overhead.
Supports web download via anchor or File System Access API.
Keeps directory handles across restarts on all platforms.
weaknesses: Large dependency tree (ffi, jni, path_provider_windows, dir_picker).
Web support limited to browsers that allow File System Access API.
data.setup_notes: Add required permissions in AndroidManifest (WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE), iOS Info.plist (NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription, etc.), macOS entitlements for sandboxed apps, and optionally a FileProvider for file:// URIs. No build_runner needed.
